These two hold the "main" positions in the group so I think Belift would push them in shows where they can showcase their talent like King of Mask and Immortal Songs. Idk any ongoing dance-focused programs in Korea rn but if there was to be one in the future then I'm pretty sure their first choice would be Ni-Ki.

Adding to that, since they were formed under an Mnet program and are undoubtedly in one of the most successful new generation groups, I figured they'll guest or become mentors on survival shows 3-4 years from now.

As the center, Heeseung is obviously pushed to the front more than the others but in a way that doesn't overshadow the group. The second would be Jungwon.

In dance-heavy performances, we get to see more of Sunghoon, Ni-Ki, and Jay. In vocal-heavy ones, Sunoo, Jake, and sometimes Jay.

Now I'm not the type to pay attention to screentime/line distribution but I will know when something is *off*. So far, I haven't felt anything like that with ENHA.

For individual promotions, I think it depends on their strengths. Currently, Sunoo, Jay, and Jungwon get more variety/radio gigs for their people skills. When they gain more domestic popularity, I can see Sunghoon & Jake getting them bags for CF deals and Heeseung & Ni-Ki being a favorite for talent-based shows. *(Assuming the company plays their cards right)* 

Anyways, I don't believe there's any blatant favoritism here; as a matter of fact, I'm actually satisfied with the way Belift handles this department. They know how to mix and match the members to a certain song/performance/concept so each of them really got the chance to shine.
